integrity: The source field model and defining set are reconstructed exactly. All 1023 nonzero codewords and all 174251 two-dimensional message subspaces are enumerated, and support sizes are computed directly from coordinate bitsets.
scientific_limitations: The result is an exact finite classification for the displayed m=10, a1=alpha, a2=alpha^2 example only; it does not classify all [231,10,104] codes or give a whole-family higher-support formula.
title: Second-support spectrum of the Xiang–Song \([231,10,104]\) Gold-type code
